system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Liberation alignment claim attribution",
    "detail": "Amplifying claims that adversarial parties share objectives (like 'liberation') to suggest consensus where fundamental disagreement exists.",
    "debias": "Distinguish between stated diplomatic positions and actual policy objectives, noting areas of fundamental disagreement.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Israel, Lebanon united in liberating Lebanon from Hezbollah, Israeli ambassador to US says",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/israel-lebanon-united-in-liberating-lebanon-from-hezbollah-israeli-ambassador-to-us-says",
    "unbiased_text": "Israel's ambassador to the US stated that Lebanese officials expressed opposition to Hezbollah's influence, though Lebanon has not publicly endorsed Israeli military objectives or terminology regarding Hezbollah."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Magazine cover controversy amplification",
    "detail": "Elevating diplomatic social media disputes over editorial choices to major news stories, amplifying controversy beyond its significance.",
    "debias": "Report magazine covers as editorial decisions without disproportionate focus on diplomatic Twitter reactions.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Prominent left-leaning Italian weekly L'Espresso is at the centre of a diplomatic storm online, after the Israeli ambassador to Italy slammed its choice of front cover as \"manipulative\".",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/l-abuso-real-italian-magazine-cover-of-israeli-settler-sparks-online-storm",
    "unbiased_text": "Italian weekly L'Espresso featured an armed Israeli settler on its cover, prompting criticism from Israel's ambassador to Italy."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Apartheid inevitability conditional framing",
    "detail": "Presenting apartheid as an inevitable outcome contingent on specific policy failures, using authoritative sources to frame political preferences as predictions.",
    "debias": "Report political opinions about potential outcomes as viewpoints rather than conditional certainties.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Israel is \"heading to apartheid\" unless it divides the land with the Palestinians.",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/t%C3%AAte-%C3%A0-t%C3%AAte/20260415-if-we-don-t-divide-the-land-we-re-heading-to-apartheid-ex-head-of-israel-s-shin-bet",
    "unbiased_text": "Former Shin Bet head Ami Ayalon argued that without a land division agreement with Palestinians, Israel risks creating an apartheid-like system."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Hostile actor geographic embeddedness assertion",
    "detail": "Characterizing militant groups as occupying state territory through framing language suggesting foreign occupation parallels.",
    "debias": "Describe armed groups' territorial presence without occupation language that conflates them with foreign invaders.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "The ​Lebanese government made ​it clear during U.S.-brokered talks ​with ‌Israel ⁠that ‌they no longer want to ⁠be \"occupied\" by Hezbollah",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/israel-lebanon-united-in-liberating-lebanon-from-hezbollah-israeli-ambassador-to-us-says",
    "unbiased_text": "The Lebanese government indicated during U.S.-brokered talks with Israel that they want Hezbollah to reduce its military presence"
  }
]
